senses.gloss: f. (= שׁוּעֲתָא; cmp. טוּנָא = טוּעֲנָא; שְׁעֵי) talk.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:2">Kidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>השתא ש׳ דמר וכ׳</he> now I do not understand your talk at all.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 39a:4">B. Bath. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>לא תיפוק לכו ש׳</he> let no talk come from you, do not talk about it; <he>לא מפקינן ש׳</he> we shall not talk about it.
<cite ref="Sukkah 56b:7">Succ. 56ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00431"><he>יָנוּקָא</he> I</cite>; a. e.
